question.text: A Cat III AIF must determine NAV on every Business Day in which:

answer.text: The fund deals/executes trades (for MTM at close of last securities market)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, NAV is computed on close of business of the last securities market on every Business Day the fund deals/executes trades. The Trap: Other triggers are unrelated. Cross-Exam Context: Standard MTM requirement. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Define 'dealing day' clearly in PPM to anchor NAV frequency.
